The '''Shadda Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebulosity]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Toblain sector/Legends|Toblain sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It consisted of luminous, tracery-like patterns of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] formed when the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Shadda (star)|Shadda]] of the [[Bi-Boran Cluster]]'s [[Shadda-Bi-Boran system]] expanded into the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] phase eons prior to [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]], shedding its outer layers in the process.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadda Nebula was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-18.<ref name="TEA" />
